Question Choices: Convert 7/10 into an equivalent fraction with a denominator of 100.
Hints: Multiply numerator and denominator by the same nonzero factor.
Solution: The scale factor is 100 / 10 = 10. Apply it to both parts: 7/10 = 70/100. Check by reversing the scale. The missing numerator is 70.
